text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rob Roy! What'd you get me for<n>my birthday,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... it's... I-I'm so sorry,<n>Sweep. About your
present...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wha... D-don't tell me. You didn't get<n>anything? For
the birthday of a great<n>witch?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not it. I did get you a gift...<n>but it ran
away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Is that a joke? What kind of<n>excuse—wait, what? It
ran?! Wow,<n>you found a familiar for me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No. Actually, it's a spell book... I<n>happened to find it
at an antique<n>bookstore, but I couldn't read a word
in it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It had streams of strange letters... and<n>illustrations
of magic circles... I'm<n>positive it must be... a
grimoire!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For it to simply vanish... It must have<n>run away on
its own. Ah, perhaps it's<n>due to the magical power
it<n>possesses!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A book that uses its own magic? This<n>is bad! Rob
Roy, get your stuff—we've<n>gotta find it so I can get
my hands on<n>it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe... She looks so thrilled. ♪ It took<n>ages to come
up with that writing, but<n>it was well worth the
trouble.)
